info.title: Data Model API
info.description:
The Data Model API provides read access to the tenant's configuration structure — entity types, relation types, source systems, and individual type definitions. While the Business Configuration API (`GET/PUT /configuration`) manages the full L3 configuration as a single object, the Data Model API offers granular endpoints for reading specific parts of the configuration.

These endpoints are essential for:
- **UI applications** that need to render dynamic forms based on entity type attributes
- **Integration pipelines** that need to discover available entity types and sources
- **Data governance tools** that inspect the data model structure

All endpoints support an optional `inheritance` parameter that controls whether inherited definitions from parent verticals are included in the response.

environment.description: Reltio environment name (e.g. dev, qa, prod)

get.description:
Retrieves the tenant-specific (L3) configuration layer *without* resolving inheritance from parent verticals. Returns only the overrides and additions defined at the tenant level.

Use this when editing the configuration — you want to modify only the tenant's own layer without accidentally including inherited definitions.

Retrieves all entity types defined in the tenant configuration. Each entity type includes its attributes, match rules, survivorship groups, display patterns, and other settings.

Use the `inheritance` query parameter to control whether entity types inherited from parent verticals are included.

Retrieves all relation types defined in the tenant configuration. Each relation type specifies its start/end entity types, direction, attributes, and survivorship rules.

Examples: EmployedBy, HasAddress, AffiliatedWith, Subsidiary, Contact.

post.description:
Appends a new source system to the tenant configuration. Sources represent upstream systems (CRM, ERP, data vendors) that contribute data. Every crosswalk on an entity or relation must reference a registered source.

This endpoint adds a source without requiring a full configuration PUT — useful for onboarding new data feeds.

get.description:
Retrieves a specific object type definition by its name. The `objectType` path parameter specifies the category (entityTypes, relationTypes, groupTypes, graphTypes, interactionTypes, categoryTypes), and `typeName` specifies the type name.

Example: `GET /configuration/entityTypes/Person` returns the full Person entity type definition.

parameters.name: typeName
parameters.description: The type name (e.g., Person, Organization, HasAddress).

EntityType.title: Entity Type
EntityType.description: Defines a business entity type (e.g., Person, Organization) with its attributes, matching, survivorship, and display settings.

uri.description: Path to the entity type. Example: `configuration/entityTypes/Individual`.

extendsTypeUri.description: Parent type URI for single inheritance.

abstract.description: When true, this type cannot be instantiated directly — it serves as a base for child types.

typeIcon.description: Icon path for facets and lists.

dataLabelPattern.description: Pattern for building display labels. Example: `{FirstName} {LastName}`.

attributes.description: Attribute definitions for this entity type.

matchGroups.description: Match rule groups for duplicate detection.

survivorshipGroups.description: Survivorship rule groups for golden record assembly.

matchBeforeCreate.description: Whether to evaluate match rules before creating new entities.

RelationType.title: Relation Type
RelationType.description: Defines a relationship type connecting two entity types.

startObject.description: Start endpoint — entity type or role URI.

endObject.description: End endpoint — entity type or role URI.

implicit.description: Whether the platform auto-creates reverse relations.

Source.title: Source System
Source.description: A registered source system that contributes data to the tenant.

abbreviation.description: Short code used in crosswalk references.

generator.description: Generator name if autoGenerated is true.
